newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia consolidate against Tasmania.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia consolidate against Tasmania.

text.p: South Australia middle order pair Joe Scuderi and Tim Nielsen have consolidated their side's first innings to frustrate Tasmania in their Sheffield Shield match.
Resuming on 251 for five, Scuderi and Nielsen lifted the total to 276 without further loss during the morning session on the second day at Bellerive Oval.
Scuderi remained unbeaten on 32 alongside Nielsen on 38 not out.
After surviving for 90 minutes before close of play on Tuesday, the pair brought up their 50 partnership off 196 balls in six minutes under two hours.
Openers Ben Johnson and Martin Faull laid the platform for the innings with a century first-wicket partnership.
Tasmania's failure to break through frustrated captain David Boon in his search for a victory that would lift his side into second place on the Shield table behind leaders Western Australia.
